Function copy_items_into_array

pub fn copy_items_into_array<T, let N: u32, let M: u32>(
    array1: [T; N],
    start_index: u32,
    array2: [T; M],
    num_items_to_copy: u32,
) -> [T; N]

where
    T: Eq

Copies up to num_items_to_copy items from array2 into array1, starting at start_index, and returns a new array with the modifications.

  • Fails if writing array2[i] into array1[start_index + i] would exceed the bounds of array1.
  • Only the first num_items_to_copy elements of array2 are copied.
  • At most array2.len() items from array2 will be copied.

Note: This function may silently stop copying from array2 once array2 ends. It's the caller's responsibility to ensure that num_items_to_copy is not greater than array2.len() if this is desired.
